name: Acceptance suite-2 test 48 - wildcard inside a Principal ARN (fail closed)
note: IAM-903: an AWS Principal-element ARN using a partial wildcard to denote multiple principals (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/application/*) is INVALID - the IAM Principal element cannot wildcard-match a principal name/ARN (only the standalone Principal "*" is accepted). The engine must NOT accept it as an ordinary TRUST-CROSS-ACCOUNT high and must NOT expand it into trust for every role in the path. It fails closed to a caveated TRUST-INVALID-PRINCIPAL finding plus an INVALID_PRINCIPAL_WILDCARD_ARN coverage warning (coverage incomplete). analyze() still succeeds (ok:true) - this is a coverage warning, not a hard block.
